title: New Year Shopping
statementMd:
Dohyun is running a grocery store. He sells $*n*$ items numbered by integers from 1 to $*n*$. The $*i*$-th ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) of them costs $*c*_{*i*}$ dollars, and if I buy it, my happiness increases by $*h*_{*i*}$. Each item can be displayed only for $*p*$ units of time because of freshness. As Dohyun displays the $*i*$-th item at time $*t*_{*i*}$, the customers can buy the $*i*$-th item only from time $*t*_{*i*}$ to time $*t*_{*i*} + (*p* - 1)$ inclusively. Also, each customer cannot buy the same item more than once.

I'd like to visit Dohyun's grocery store and buy some items for the New Year Party, and maximize my happiness. Because I am a really busy person, I can visit the store only once, and for very short period of time. In other words, if I visit the store at time $*t*$, I can only buy the items available at time $*t*$. But I can buy as many items as possible, if the budget holds. I can't buy same item several times due to store rules. It is not necessary to use the whole budget.

I made a list of $*q*$ pairs of integers $(*a*_{*j*}, *b*_{*j*})$, which means I may visit the store at time $*a*_{*j*}$, and spend at most $*b*_{*j*}$ dollars at the store. For each pair, I'd like to know the maximum happiness I can obtain. But there are so many pairs that I can't handle them. Can you help me?

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*p*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 4000$, $1 ≤ *p* ≤ 10 000$) — the number of items, and the display time of each item.

Next $*n*$ lines describe the items. The $*i*$-th ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) of them contains three space-separated integers $*c*_{*i*}$, $*h*_{*i*}$, $*t*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*}, *h*_{*i*} ≤ 4000$, $1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10 000$) — the cost of the $*i*$-th item, the happiness of the $*i*$-th item, and the time when the $*i*$-th item starts to be displayed.

The next line contains an integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 20 000$)— the number of candidates.

Next $*q*$ lines describe the candidates. The $*j*$-th ($1 ≤ *j* ≤ *q*$) of them contains two space-separated integers $*a*_{*j*}$, $*b*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*j*} ≤ 20 000$, $1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ 4000$) — the visit time and the budget for $*j*$-th visit of store.

## Output

For each candidate, print a single line containing the maximum happiness that I can obtain by buying some items.

## Note

Consider the first sample.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4fdef44e261d78979f758b2e006fed9f759fcfc4.png)

1. At time 1, only the 2nd item is available. I can buy the 2nd item using 3 dollars and my happiness will increase by 5.
2. At time 2, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd item is available. I can buy the 1st item using 2 dollars, and the 2nd item using 3 dollars. My happiness will increase by 3 + 5 = 8.
3. At time 2, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd item is available. I can buy the 1st item using 2 dollars, and the 3nd item using 4 dollars. My happiness will increase by 3 + 7 = 10.
4. At time 5, the 1st, 3rd, and 4th item is available. I can buy the 1st item using 2 dollars, and the 4th item using 11 dollars. My happiness will increase by 3 + 15 = 18. Note that I don't need to use the whole budget in this case.
statementZhMd:
Dohyun 经营着一家杂货店。他出售 $*n*$ 件商品，编号为从 1 到 $*n*$ 的整数。第 $*i*$ 件（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）商品的价格为 $*c*_{*i*}$ 美元，购买它后我的幸福感会增加 $*h*_{*i*}$。由于新鲜度的原因，每件商品只能展示 $*p*$ 个时间单位。当 Dohyun 在时刻 $*t*_{*i*}$ 展示第 $*i*$ 件商品时，顾客只能在从时刻 $*t*_{*i*}$ 到时刻 $*t*_{*i*} + (*p* - 1)$（包括两端）的时间段内购买该商品。此外，每位顾客不能购买同一件商品超过一次。

我想去 Dohyun 的杂货店购买一些新年聚会所需的商品，并使我的幸福感最大化。由于我非常忙，只能去商店一次，而且停留的时间非常短。换句话说，如果我在时刻 $*t*$ 到店，那么我只能购买在时刻 $*t*$ 可购买的商品。但只要预算允许，我可以购买任意多件商品。由于商店的规定，我不能多次购买同一件商品。不必花完全部预算。

我列出了 $*q*$ 对整数 $(*a*_{*j*}, *b*_{*j*})$，表示我可能在时刻 $*a*_{*j*}$ 到店，并且最多在商店花费 $*b*_{*j*}$ 美元。对于每一对，我想知道自己能够获得的最大幸福感。但这样的询问太多了，我无法自行处理。你能帮助我吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*p*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 4000$，$1 ≤ *p* ≤ 10 000$）——商品数量，以及每件商品的展示时间。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述商品。第 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）行包含三个以空格分隔的整数 $*c*_{*i*}$、$*h*_{*i*}$、$*t*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*}, *h*_{*i*} ≤ 4000$，$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10 000$）——第 $*i*$ 件商品的价格、第 $*i*$ 件商品带来的幸福感，以及第 $*i*$ 件商品开始展示的时刻。

下一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 20 000$）——候选方案的数量。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行描述候选方案。第 $*j*$（$1 ≤ *j* ≤ *q*$）行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*j*}$、$*b*_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*j*} ≤ 20 000$，$1 ≤ *b*_{*j*} ≤ 4000$）——第 $*j*$ 次到店的时刻和预算。

## 输出格式

对于每个候选方案，输出一行一个整数，表示通过购买若干件商品所能获得的最大幸福感。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4fdef44e261d78979f758b2e006fed9f759fcfc4.png)

1. 在时刻 1，只有第 2 件商品可购买。我可以花费 3 美元购买第 2 件商品，幸福感将增加 5。
2. 在时刻 2，第 1、2、3 件商品均可购买。我可以花费 2 美元购买第 1 件商品，再花费 3 美元购买第 2 件商品。幸福感将增加 3 + 5 = 8。
3. 在时刻 2，第 1、2、3 件商品均可购买。我可以花费 2 美元购买第 1 件商品，再花费 4 美元购买第 3 件商品。幸福感将增加 3 + 7 = 10。
4. 在时刻 5，第 1、3、4 件商品均可购买。我可以花费 2 美元购买第 1 件商品，再花费 11 美元购买第 4 件商品。幸福感将增加 3 + 15 = 18。注意，这种情况下不必花完全部预算。
